_readme: The stations players get: NIGERIAN stations only (lib/radio/stations.js rejects any other). This file is written by tools/radio/verify-browser.mjs --write, which plays every station in a real browser and keeps only the ones that really play. Do not add a station here by hand: add it as a candidate (tools/radio/candidates.json, or tools/radio/discover-nigeria.mjs) and verify it. Streams are public listening streams the stations publish; confirm each station's terms. The build (tools/radio/verify-stations.mjs --check --write --soft) only re-checks and removes streams that are definitely gone; it never adds one.
